text: Almost every lesson left in this course happens inside one work area: Setup and Maintenance. Before we touch legal entities, ledgers, or segments, let's learn how it's organized.

Oracle Fusion organizes setup work in three nested levels. An offering is a big product area, like Financials. Each offering breaks into functional areas. Each functional area contains individual setup tasks — the actual clickable steps.

This course lives almost entirely inside the Financials offering, mostly in two functional areas: Enterprise Profile, covering legal entities, business units and locations, and Ledger and Reporting Configuration, covering ledgers, chart of accounts, calendars and currencies.

The full task list can run into hundreds of tasks. Instead of browsing the whole tree, use the search box and type part of a task name, like "chart of accounts." That's how most working consultants actually find a task day to day.

Offering, functional area, task — that's the shape of Setup and Maintenance. Next up, lesson three: a bird's-eye view of enterprise structures themselves, before we configure any piece of them individually.
